question: The headquarters of the Indian Institute of Tourism and Travel Management are located at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gwalior**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The headquarters of the Indian Institute of Tourism and Travel Management (IITTM) are located in **Gwalior**.
 
• IITTM is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India.
 
• It offers education, training, research, and consultancy in the field of tourism, travel, and related sectors.
 
• The institute aims to provide quality education and training to develop skilled professionals for the tourism and travel industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian Institute of Tourism and Travel Management was established in 1983.
 
• It has several regional centers located in Bhubaneswar, Noida, Nellore, and Goa.
 
• IITTM is recognized for its academic excellence and industry-oriented programs.
 
• The institute collaborates with various national and international organizations to enhance its academic and research capabilities.
